adjustSubtitle: This moves money in the customer's wallet. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Compensation for failed order INV-001
deleteUserDescription: This permanently removes the customer account. This action cannot be undone.
channelDeleteBlocked: Channels with transactions cannot be deleted. Deactivate instead.
paymentSubtitle: Channels offered at checkout, shown here for reference.
usersSubtitle:
Admin and member accounts on this site: role, wallet balance, points and standing. Balance adjustments are audited
          and require a reason; suspend or ban blocks an account from transacting. Select a name for the full detail.
saveConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to Save all this data?
group_general_help: Site identity and the global switches that apply to every page.
group_contact_help: How customers reach you — shown in the storefront footer and contact blocks.
group_social_help: Social profile links. Only networks with a URL appear on the storefront.
group_seo_help: Metadata search engines and link previews use when the site is shared.
group_payment_help: Presets and limits for topping up a member's wallet balance.
group_points_help: Loyalty points: how much an order earns, and what a point is worth.
group_operational_help: How long a pending payment stays payable. Nothing here is exposed publicly.
group_licence_help: This site's subscription to the platform. Reported here, managed from the Hub.
help_site_name: The brand name shown in the storefront header, page titles and receipts.
help_site_tagline: A short marketing line shown under the logo on the home page.
help_logo: Header logo. SVG and ICO keep their format; a transparent PNG works best on a dark header.
help_favicon: The icon in the browser tab and bookmarks. Square, at least 32×32.
help_maintenance_mode: Takes the storefront offline with a maintenance notice. The admin panel stays reachable.
help_footer_description: Short paragraph in the storefront footer. Blank falls back to the built-in translation.
help_copyright_text: Copyright line in the footer. Blank uses the default.
help_contact_whatsapp: Number customers are sent to. International format, digits only — e.g. 6281234567890.
help_contact_email: Support address shown on the storefront, and the reply-to on customer email.
help_contact_address: Business address shown on the contact page and footer.
help_operational_hours: Support hours, written as customers should read them — e.g. 24 Jam.
help_social_instagram: Full profile URL. Blank hides the icon on the storefront.
help_social_tiktok: Full profile URL. Blank hides the icon.
help_social_youtube: Full profile URL. Blank hides the icon.
help_social_facebook: Full profile URL. Blank hides the icon.
help_social_x: Full profile URL. Blank hides the icon.
help_social_linkedin: Full profile URL. Blank hides the icon.
help_meta_title: Title search engines and link previews show. Keep it under 60 characters.
help_meta_description: Summary under the title in search results and link previews. 150–160 characters.
help_og_image: Preview image used when the site is shared. 1200×630 is the safe size.
help_balance_topup_presets: JSON array of nominal amounts offered as quick picks on the wallet top-up form.
help_min_topup_amount: Smallest wallet top-up accepted, in rupiah.
help_earn_percent: Used when a product leaves its own earn field blank and falls back here. Filling 0 on a product means that SKU earns nothing — blank and 0 are not the same.
help_earn_flat: Flat points per order, used when a product leaves its own bonus field blank. Filling 0 on a product means it earns none.
help_redeem_rate: What one point is worth in rupiah when redeemed at checkout.
help_order_expiry_minutes: How long a pending payment stays payable, per payment method. The methods differ by hours — a virtual account dies in minutes, a convenience store in a day. A method left blank keeps its built-in window.
presetsEmptyHint: No quick amounts yet. Add one so the top-up form offers it.
licenceUnconfigured: No platform service is configured for this site, so there is nothing to report. Once the Hub links it, the status and renewal date show up here.
